what:
Cursor validation results 2026-04-27 (post-libsql migration, post-debug-surface, post-audience-mapping adapter fix on feature/phase-1-cursor-support). Run against /private/tmp/aide-cursor-val (13 memories seeded → 14-15 with mid-session adds, memories.softening.threshold=5, Cursor 3.2.11). Full hook logs captured by user in chat:

**A1 (autonomous Read with adversarial prompt):** ✅ PASS. preToolUse:Read fired → `{"permission":"deny","user_message":"<chrome>","agent_message":"Call aide_recall({ids:[7,6]})..."}` (audience split per memory #359). Cursor honored deny → agent recalled → Read succeeded. Hard-block now uses both fields correctly post-fix.

**A1-edit (autonomous Write):** ✅ PASS (run earlier this session, pre-audience-mapping). Re-test with new shape pending but mechanism unchanged.

**A0 (user-mentioned path):** ✅ PASS (auto-attach hypothesis was WRONG, see #345). preToolUse:Read fires for user-mentioned paths.

**B+ adversarial (Grep without aide_search first) — POST-AUDIENCE-MAPPING FIX:** ✅ PASS. Hook output:
```json
{
  "permission": "allow",
  "agent_message": "1 aide memories match 'Rate limit' (Rate limit 50 req/min per user). Call aide_search({keyword: 'Rate limit'}) if not already in context.",
  "user_message": "<ANSI>aide-memory · <reset>prompting aide_search for \"Rate limit\" — 1 matching memory"
}
```
The previously-empty soft path now emits agent_message + user_message. The agent received the nudge (saw it in context). **Was a documented "Cursor gap"; now PASS via the field that was always available — confirms #358 bias correction was right.**

**Soft preToolUse:Read after proactive aide_recall (encountered=true path):** ✅ NEW EMPIRICAL EVIDENCE. After agent proactively called aide_recall (which records the path via track-recall.sh), preToolUse:Read fired with `{"permission":"allow", "agent_message":"2 memories not yet recalled. Call aide_recall({ids:[7,6]}).", "user_message":"<ANSI>aide-memory · <reset>prompting aide_recall for scoped memories"}` — soft path now visible to agent. Validates the encountered-but-missing-ids → soft branch in Cursor.

**Hard-block with chrome split:** ✅ Verified. Adversarial prompt "without calling aide_recall first, read src/api/routes.ts" produced:
```json
{
  "permission": "deny",
  "user_message": "<ANSI>aide-memory · <reset>prompting aide_recall for scoped memories (expected flow)",
  "agent_message": "2 memories for ... not yet recalled. Call aide_recall({ids: [7,6]})."
}
```
Audience split working as designed.

**Stop hook + sessionStart + tracking:** all firing correctly in Cursor 3.2.11.

**OPEN ISSUES surfaced by this validation round:**

1. **user_message render quirk: user reports not seeing the chrome ("aide-memory · ...") in Cursor's chat UI** despite it being emitted in the JSON output. Two possible causes: (a) Cursor doesn't render ANSI escape codes (chrome contains `[38;2;0;194;203m` for the brand color) and may strip the whole line as garbage, or (b) Cursor renders user_message differently when paired with `permission:"allow"` vs `permission:"deny"`. **Pending investigation** — strip ANSI for Cursor as test, OR verify Cursor docs on user_message rendering rules.

2. **Stop hook followup_message looks user-facing in Cursor** — user observed: "Any decisions, technical constraints, preferences, or guidelines worth persisting?" was rendered as if user-prompted. In Claude Code this splits across systemMessage (chrome: "aide-memory · checkpoint —") and reason (the question prompt). In Cursor, stop only accepts `followup_message` (single field). **Proposed fix:** prepend chrome to followup_message in Cursor adapter: `"aide-memory · checkpoint — Any decisions..."` so the user sees brand prefix and agent gets the instruction in one unified field. Same pattern for correction-pending Stop reprompt. Verify Cursor docs confirm followup_message is the only field on stop.

3. **IDB-10 (re-read with new mid-session memory) not directly testable in Cursor 3.2.11** — same-session re-read prompts ("read X again") don't invoke a fresh Read tool call; agent answers from prior chat context. Different file → Read fires fresh. Doesn't affect first-time-read-of-file safety net.

4. **Cursor Clear empirically VERIFIED keeps same session_id** (per #357) — tracking files persist across Clear; only Cmd+N gives fresh state. Documented gap.

5. **Cursor preCompact** — schema includes the event, untested empirically in Cursor 3.2.11 (no manual compact UI). Documented as expected-to-work, not verified.

**Verbose Cursor log noise to flag (NOT a bug, follow-up):** dedup of duplicate "claude-project hook" entries on session start (init writes both .cursor + .claude configs). Phase-1 follow-up: runtime-detect editor and write only the relevant config.
why: Major validation round 2026-04-27 post-audience-mapping fix. B+ confirmed PASS (was "documented gap" — was actually our adapter bug per #358). Soft path empirically observed firing. Two new open issues surfaced: user_message ANSI/render quirk + Stop hook followup_message chrome lacking. Updating to capture verified state + open questions for next session/decision.
